new_assertions.body: The phase-factored component-parity carrier is strictly scalar in the tested corpus: it is Q-V exact on eight carriers but Q-A-inexact on every carrier where it makes a nontrivial merge.
Exact rank does not restore Q-A after parity reduction; the discarded action information is component/action multiplicity and type structure rather than a missing global rank phase.
T2-W and T2-L2 are scalar absorbing categories whose exact values follow directly from mover identity, so action multiplicity can be safely forgotten for Q-V while remaining load-bearing for Q-A.
Q-A collisions also occur inside T2-O, so the strict Q-V/Q-A separation is not merely an artifact of terminal tactical short-circuit states.
The scalar evaluator-discovery frontier should condition on T2-O and seek a valuation of the phase-factored parity carrier there; restoring Q-A distinctions would defeat the Q-V minimality objective.
Q-A and Q-V now require separate minimization tracks: a finer action carrier can coexist with a smaller scalar carrier and a direct D_G.
